definition_text: Forest - Land spanning more than 0.5 hectares with trees higher than 5 metres and a canopy cover of more than 10 percent
Forest - A contiguous area of land with more than 60 percent crown cover of trees, able to reach a height of 5 meters at maturity
Forest - An area of land with forest vegetation where forest area is minimum 1 hectare and tree crown coverage is not less than 10 percent
